name: Malchus (the high priest's servant)
title: The Servant Who Was Healed
summary: Malchus was a servant of the high priest Caiaphas who was part of the group that came to arrest Jesus in Gethsemane. He is known for having his ear cut off by Peter and then being healed by Jesus in His last miracle before the crucifixion.

keyEvents.title: The Arrest in Gethsemane
keyEvents.description: Malchus was part of the group of guards and servants who came to arrest Jesus in the Garden of Gethsemane, led by Judas Iscariot.

keyEvents.title: Peter Cuts Off the Ear
keyEvents.description: Peter drew his sword and cut off Malchus's right ear in an attempt to defend Jesus against the arrest.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Heals Malchus
keyEvents.description: Jesus rebuked Peter, touched Malchus's ear, and healed him—Jesus's last miracle before the crucifixion, demonstrating His love even toward His enemies.

keyEvents.title: Jesus Surrenders Voluntarily
keyEvents.description: After healing Malchus, Jesus allowed himself to be arrested willingly and reminded his disciples that he could have called on angels for defense, but that Scripture had to be fulfilled.
